prompt: Image 1 is a grey clay sculpt of a muscular humanoid, photographed by a camera hovering directly above it and looking straight down at the ground: a plan view, like a miniature seen from above on a tabletop map. The figure stands upright with both arms stretched straight out to the sides. The round dome in the centre is the top of its bald skull, with the crown at the centre of the dome. The thin strip on the lower edge of the dome is the brow ridge, the nose tip and two tusk tips jutting forward. The wide horizontal band is the tops of the shoulders and upper back; the bars to the left and right are the arms seen from above, ending in flat hands with the backs of the hands facing the camera. The rounded bulge below the shoulders is the chest and belly seen from above, and the two small bumps at the bottom are the toe tips. Paint this exact clay figure as a finished game character: an orc with olive-green skin, bald scalp, pointed ears, heavy muscles and ivory tusk tips. Keep the identical outline, pose, proportions, position, scale and straight-down viewpoint of the clay figure, tracing its silhouette precisely. Paint the dome as a smooth bald green scalp seen from above with a soft highlight on the crown. Paint the shoulder band as trapezius, deltoid and shoulder-blade muscles seen from above. Hand-painted semi-realistic game-art style with soft shading and a soft dark outline, lit evenly from above, on the same flat uniform mid-grey background. Bare unclothed base body, left-right symmetric.
